event_definition: cached frame with start <= source_frame_index <= end for any official span
head: step_permuted (train permute seed 1000+seed, val permute seed 2000+seed, sampling_seed 0)
head_init: torch.manual_seed(seed) before head construction (deviation: headline script leaves init unseeded)
sampler: event/anti/uniform8: k=8 midpoints of k equal segments over the candidate frames sorted by source_frame_index (repeats if fewer than 8), then permuted with default_rng(2000+seed); uniform: headline path (all cached frames, permuted, 8-frame chunks, mean logits)
seed_averaging: mean softmax probability over seeds per (fold, video)
